description:
Today i share how to Travel to Thailand in 2022 with the Test and Go Programme. 

I stayed at the "Ny city resort & spa" for my Quarantine(Day 1 & Day 5) 
Their email and contact number for booking(or any questions): nycity2499@gmail.com(📱mobile/whatsapp +66988282421
My Insurance for Travel (needed right now to enter Thailand): https://www.icicilombard.com/

Hello, I'm Anurag SINGH .

I like to travel around new countries of the world, and through this channel I will try to show you this beautiful world ,try to show you my experience and show that how incredible the world is! I try to travel on a budget, because i'm a working person, i save some money for travel and make my travel in budget, currently i'm  part time traveler but if you guys support me then in future i'll be full time travler. I make videos in Hindi to make aware people in India that travelling is not expensive thing.. 

For  Business inquiries :- nomadlersingh@gmail.com

Thank You
